data.body: **[P2] Track ambiguous invocations before allowing function reuse.** If Lambda accepts the invocation but its response is lost, this path saves only the payload and raises before adding anything to `self.invocations`. Per-case teardown consequently cannot stop or observe that execution; with no other invocations, it skips settlement polling entirely. The next case can reuse a function still occupied by the failed case. Register the marker before invoking, recover its ARN from the ledger during teardown, and block reuse until settlement is established. Add a lost-response teardown test.
